claim.claim-text: 1. A gas extraction system for an extracorporeal ventilation system, the gas extraction system comprising:

an exhaust gas removal line for connection to an external exhaust suction port; a sampling line; and a connection merging the sampling line and the exhaust gas removal line to allow suction from the exhaust suction port to be applied to the sampling line, wherein the sampling line comprises an outlet port for passively venting when not connected to the exhaust suction port.

2. The gas extraction system of claim 1, further comprising a flow restrictor for the sampling line, the flow restrictor allowing the flow rate in at least a portion of the sampling line to be reduced relative to the exhaust line when suction from the exhaust suction port is applied to the flow restrictor.
3. The gas extraction system of claim 2, wherein the flow restrictor is an orifice plate.
4. The gas extraction system of claim 2 or claim 3, further comprising a sensor arrangement in the portion of the sampling line with reduced flow.
5. The gas extraction system of claim 4, wherein the sensor arrangement comprises an oxygen sensor, a carbon dioxide sensor and/or an anaesthesia sensor.
6. The gas extraction system of any preceding claim, further comprising an assisted venous drainage line for connection to a drainage suction port.
7. The gas extraction system of claim 6, wherein a connection of the drainage suction port to the assisted venous drainage line is isolated from the exhaust gas removal line.

8. The gas extraction system of claim 6 or claim 7, further comprising control logic configurable to modulate the suction flow rate of the drainage line differently from the suction flow rate of the exhaust gas removal line.

9. The gas extraction system of any of claims 6 to 8, further comprising control logic configurable to modulate the suction pressure of the drainage line differently from the suction pressure of the exhaust gas removal line.
